## Newsletter

::: {#subscribe}
<form action="https://buttondown.com/api/emails/embed-subscribe/openwashdata" method="post" class="owd-subscribe">
<label for="owd-email-newsletter">One email a month: a dataset, a story, and the community's news.</label>
<input type="email" name="email" id="owd-email-newsletter" placeholder="your email address" required>
<input type="submit" value="Subscribe">
</form>
:::

Every issue features one dataset from the catalogue with a chart and the
numbers behind it, one story from the community, and the news: new data
packages, courses, events, and ways to get involved. Issues go out on the
first Monday of the month. Unsubscribe with one click in any issue.

Past issues are in the [newsletter archive](https://buttondown.com/openwashdata/archive/).
